name: sales-commission
description: Work out each salesperson's commission from a sales sheet and hand out clear statements. Set tiered rates — progressive like tax brackets, or whole-tier where reaching a level pays that rate on everything — give products such as accessories or services their own rates, and let refunds and cancellations claw back what was paid. Filter to a month, see every line's rate and commission, and catch duplicate orders, refunds booked under the wrong person and names spelled two ways. Export a summary workbook and a one-page PDF statement per person. Runs locally; no CRM login or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 从销售明细表算出每位销售的提成，并生成清楚的个人提成单。设置阶梯比例——超额累进（像个税一样每档只算该档部分）或全额阶梯（达到哪档全部按哪档）；配件、服务等品类可以单独设比例；退货、取消的订单自动扣回提成。可以只算某个月，每一行的比例和提成都看得到，还会提示重复订单、退货记错人、同一个人名字写法不一致。导出提成汇总 Excel 和每人一页的 PDF 提成单。在本地运行，不用登录 CRM，无需 API 密钥。
